blocks.text: Hadhrat Khaalid bin Ma'daan says, "From amongst the Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ, there are none left in Shaam whose knowledge is more dependable, who have a deeper understanding and who are more beloved to the people than Hadhrat Ubaadah bin Saamit (RA) and Hadhrat Shaddaad bin Aws (RA)." [^1]
Hadhrat Handhla bin Sufyaan reports from his teachers that none had a better understanding of the Deen than Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri (RA)." [^2]
The Knowledge of Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA)

Hadhrat Abu Za'eeza'a who was Marwaan bin Hakam's scribe reports, "Marwaan once summoned Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) and, seating me behind his chair, he started questioning Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) as I wrote everything down. After a complete year had passed, Marwaan again sent for Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) and, seating him behind a screen, started asking him the same questions. Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) replied to the questions just as he did the previous year without adding, deleting or even misplacing a single word." [^3]
The Knowledge of Ummul Mu'mineen Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA)
Hadhrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari (RA) says, "Whenever the Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ had doubts about anything, they referred it to Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) and always found the answer with her." [^4]
Hadhrat Qabeesah bin Dhuwayb says, "Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) was one of the most knowledgeable personalities and even the senior Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ consulted with her." [^5]

Hadhrat Abu Salamah says, "I have not seen anyone with more knowledge of the Sunnah practices of Rasulullaah ﷺ than Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA). I have also not seen anyone offer a better opinion when an opinion was sought and seen no one with more knowledge of the circumstances surrounding the revelation of any verse or with more knowledge of the laws of inheritance." [^6]

When someone asked Hadhrat Masrooq whether Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) was proficient in the laws of inheritance, he replied, "I swear by the Being Who controls my life that she certainly was! In fact, I saw the senior Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ ask her about inheritance." [^7]

Hadhrat Mahmood bin Labeed says, "Although all the pure wives of Rasulullaah ﷺ knew many Ahadeeth, none knew as much as Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) and Hadhrat Ummu Salamah (RA). In fact, Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) used to issue
Haakim (Vol.3 Pg.510), reporting from reliable sources as confirmed by Dhahabi.
Ibn Sa'd (Vol.4 Pg.189). Tabraani has reported a similar narration from reliable sources as confirmed by Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.242).
